record.question: Which country successfully test first stealth fighter jet name X-2 recently?
record.explanation: Answer A: Japan. Japan's X-2 advanced technology demonstrator made its first flight on 22 April 2016. Its manufacturer Mitsubishi Heavy Industries describes it as Japan's first prototype incorporating this stealth technology, not a first operational stealth fighter anywhere in the world. Historical/source note: Prototype technology demonstrator; first of its kind in Japan, not the world's first operational stealth fighter. Reference: https://www.mhi.com/news/1604221975.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
